The '''Farana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana region]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farana/Legends|Farana]].
